integrity: The source formula and BMSS tangent-cone statement were checked in accessible full text. The new discriminant, line-arrangement incidence, and nine multiplicity-four specializations are derived exactly and replayed by the accompanying symbolic checker.
scientific_limitations: Only the reduced support of the marked tangent-cone discriminant is identified; scheme multiplicities of the discriminant divisor and the full singular loci of all specialized quartics are not classified.
title: The marked-point discriminant of the \(B_3\) unexpected quartic is the non-Fano arrangement
